// diagnostic E0445

Jet.CollectionLiteralMixesItemsAndLoop

This collection literal mixes items with a loop

What

This collection literal mixes items with a loop

Why

A typed head holds either its items or one loop that builds them, so a reader sees at once what makes the collection

Fix

Build the items and the loop's collection apart, then join them, such as `[0].concat(loop x in xs -> x)`

Worked example
